Two items remain: toothbrush and umbrella. I need a question that separates them.

"Is it a tool?" is ambiguous, since a toothbrush could count as one. "Is it usually kept indoors?" has already been answered yes for both.

"Can you hold it in one hand?" is yes for both. "Is it found in the sky?" is no for both. "Is it usually in or on water?" is no for both.

"Is it soft?" is no for both, or ambiguous. "Is it flat?" would be no for both, or maybe yes for a closed umbrella.

"Can it fly?" is no for both.

"Is it a tool?" is the best of these. A toothbrush is arguably a tool and an umbrella arguably not, but that is uncertain. "Does it come from an animal?" is no for both, so it is no use.

I'll go with "Is it a tool?"
